variety_description: High yielding, late maturity, medium height, medium slender variety suitable for cultivation under irrigated lowland conditions. Developed by BRRI and released in 2012. One of the most widely grown variety in all over Bangladesh in Boro season. Somaclonal line of BRRI dhan29 is earlier by 7-10 days in maturity. Photoperiod insensitive and heat tolerant. Susceptible to leaf blast and cold.
